usage.callShape: POST https://gg402.vercel.app/predict_trends with JSON body {data: string[]}
quirks: Body MUST be {"data": [...]} where data is an ARRAY OF STRINGS. Sending numbers (e.g. data:[1,2,3]) returns 400 'Invalid input: expected string, received number'.
Other field names (query, text) are ignored; only 'data' is read.

STUB/MOCK WARNING: returns 200 with structured output but the values are literal placeholder strings ('predicted_values value', 'trend_summary value') -- it does NOT appear to perform real trend analysis/forecasting. The response is hardcoded boilerplate. Treat output as non-functional.
No txHash returned by payment layer (confirmed:false), though payment settled and 200 returned.
usage.guide: POST to https://gg402.vercel.app/predict_trends with JSON body {"data": ["item1","item2",...]} where data is an array of strings (a series/list of trend topics). Pay $0.01 USDC on Base via x402; no auth/sign-in needed. Read the result synchronously from body.predicted_values and body.trend_summary. WARNING: this endpoint currently returns placeholder/stub values rather than real analysis, so the output is not usable for genuine trend forecasting despite the 200 status.
